functions.name: case
functions.spark_sql:
WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id,
        CASE id % 4 WHEN 1 THEN false WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) ELSE true END AS flag,
        CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT)
                WHEN 3 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
                ELSE CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT) END AS wide,
        CASE id % 4 WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-2147483648' AS INT)
                     WHEN 2 THEN CAST('2147483647' AS INT) ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END AS narrow
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, CASE WHEN flag THEN wide ELSE CAST(narrow AS BIGINT) END AS result FROM operands
